backrooms.description: Backrooms: Not Escape is a multiplayer horror game for 4 players with interesting mechanics that will allow you to have fun with your friends. Never enter the backrooms alone. Explore them and find a way out, but there is no guarantee that it exists.

notes.text: This game is a mess. Save system is borked. Multiplayer is borked. In-game feedback is bad or non-existent, like buttons that give no indication that they've been pressed and generators that give no clue to what they are powering, if anything. - Sark's Steam review
